summary: Braiin Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing two related-party transactions with entities under common control of President/COO Mr. Saligrama. First, Connect Simple restructuring: Mr. Saligrama and Advaitha Pty Ltd transferred shares in Connect Easy Ltd and ConnectEasy Inc to Connect Simple in exchange for new shares, resulting in them owning 97.96% of Connect Simple pre-settlement. On 2 February 2026, Braiin issued 9,636,424 shares at USD$10.17 per share to settle its acquisition of Connect Simple, with shares subject to 12-month lock-up. Second, a Note Purchase Agreement with Advaitha for a USD$12M secured non-convertible debenture (cash price USD$9.4M) to fund VIS Networks acquisition and refinance debt. This is a regulatory disclosure of related-party transactions, not a standalone special-situation event.
